POST /api/funds/lps/:lpId/sign-lpa.note: The LP whose record it is (user_id = caller), KYC approved, records the signature; an admin may too, by design. Another LP in the same fund, a founder, a partner, a revoked advisor and an investor with no LP record get 403; the LP without approved KYC gets 403; nothing is signed; no credentials or a disabled LP get 401. See D4570-p6, hardening items 1 and 2.
